title: Representation stress test
purpose: Stress NDM representation across repeated reversals, belief conflict, correction, provenance, identity ambiguity, scope separation, multi-hop causality, and explicit non-causality.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: For the payments platform, I propose PostgreSQL.

conversation.speaker: Bob
conversation.text: I think CockroachDB is better for multi-region payments.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: I accept CockroachDB for the payments platform.

conversation.speaker: Carol
conversation.text: The compliance requirement rules out CockroachDB for payments.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: Then I am reversing the decision and selecting PostgreSQL.

conversation.speaker: Carol
conversation.text: I found the compliance document. We had interpreted the requirement incorrectly.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: Correction accepted. The payments platform will use CockroachDB again.

conversation.speaker: Bob
conversation.text: That original CockroachDB decision was always the intended architecture.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: No. That is not correct. The CockroachDB choice changed over time.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: In the security-team discussion, I am Alice from the security team.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: For clarity, the Alice who owns the payments decision is Alice from the platform team.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: The payments platform deployment is complete.

conversation.speaker: Alice
conversation.text: The deployment did not cause the architectural decision; the architecture decision happened earlier.
